identity.note: Pending a verdict. A Zafirah is billed on CWC's line-up for 10 April 2008 in a singles match, four months after PWX closed, and CWC's own pages say its roster came largely from PWX; PWX's Zafirah is a 98-pound wrestler (Adrenaline 70) and a Hybrid Champion in February 2007. No page names her in both feds, and CWC's record holds only the one line-up line, so the shared name and the roster migration are a strong lead, not a merge. Revisit if CWC's 10 April 2008 results or any CWC billing of her is found.
